input.brief: LakshTech Solutions IT and software development company building premium web mobile backend products

direction.name: The printed annual
direction.idea: Lay the page out like a well-designed printed report or magazine feature: a masthead image, a tight oversized title, text held to a strict column line, and colour used in solid blocks the way a two-colour print job would. It gives weight and authority to subjects that are really about content: findings, a manifesto, a programme, a serious product. The reader should feel that someone edited this.
direction.composition: A fixed vertical axis at about 42% of the viewport width organises everything: headings begin on it, body columns hang from it, and the 0–42% zone holds small side notes, figures or stays empty. Masthead: a wide image band (photographic mosaic or a single crop) across the top 45% of the first screen; below it the title at 7–9vw starting on the axis, with a two-sentence standfirst at 20–24px. Sections alternate between text pages (title on the axis, body in one or two columns of 34–40ch to its right) and full-bleed colour pages carrying one large figure, quotation or image mosaic. Mosaics are gutterless: photographs and flat colour tiles butted together in a 4- or 6-cell grid. Page numbers, running heads and other print furniture are left out.
direction.typography: A tight heavy grotesk or a sharp serif for titles; an excellent text face for reading at 18–20px with leading near 1.5. Headings in sentence case, tracked tight.
direction.colour: Paper, ink and two or three solid block colours. A colour page is a whole section in one flat colour.
direction.imagery: Photographs used as blocks in mosaics alongside flat colour tiles; mixed subjects are fine if cropped tight and converted to one treatment.
direction.photoTreatment: Give all photographs in a mosaic one treatment: greyscale via `filter: grayscale(1) contrast(1.05)`, or all full colour. Do not mix.
direction.richness: The column line, the mosaics and whole pages of colour give structure and variety without ornaments.
direction.pitfalls: The axis must be exact and reused everywhere or it reads as random indentation. Keep paragraphs to a real reading measure. On a phone the axis collapses to the left margin and side notes move inline above their paragraph.

hero.name: Two-by-two board
hero.blueprint: A board with 8px outer margins and 8px gaps throughout; every tile is a filled rectangle with one shared radius (0 or 8px). A 60px top row is itself made of tiles: a square ink tile with the logo mark, a wide ground-tone tile holding four text links that begin at the centre line, and an ink tile at the right end holding the single action. Below it the rest of the viewport is a two-by-two grid. Top-left: a paper tile with the name, or its first word, at clamp(96px, 12.5vw, 190px), medium weight, tracking -0.05em, sitting bottom-left on 24px padding. Top-right and bottom-left: photographs covering their tiles (object-fit: cover), both greyscale so they read as one picture continued across the board. Bottom-right is divided into two tiles side by side: a dark tile with one sentence at 24px, top-left aligned, and a tile in the accent colour with a second short statement at 24px, also top-left. Text never centres inside a tile. No tile is empty and none is outlined.
hero.mobile: The board becomes one column of tiles with 6px gaps: a top row with the logo tile and a menu tile; the name tile at 30% of the screen height with the name at 22vw bottom-left; one photograph tile at 4:3; then the dark tile and the accent tile side by side as two squares. The second photograph moves below the first screen.
hero.headline: The name, or its first word, up to 8 characters at 12.5vw; the two 24px statements are one sentence each.

type.note: A serif with chiselled, angular curves and wedge serifs, sharp at display size and firm in text. Suits studios, galleries, advisory firms and written guides.

palette.name: Black and crimson
palette.note: Black with off-white text and mid-grey texture takes nearly the whole page, and the last sections may invert to off-white with black type. Deep crimson is scattered sparingly: a few characters in a heading, a slider fill, the one button.

motion.name: Shutter image
motion.description: The one hero or showcase image opens from an edge with a clip-path over about 1.1 seconds while the picture inside settles from 1.12 scale to rest. Use it once, on the image that matters most; later images simply are there. Recipe: 'Image shutter' in references/motion.md.

sections.name: Rows with margin photographs
sections.blueprint: Everything hangs from one vertical axis at column 5, about 35% of the width. First the heading: a statement of up to five words at clamp(40px, 5vw, 80px) starting on the axis, vertically centred in an otherwise empty 70svh of ground. Then four or five benefit rows, each starting on the same axis: a title at clamp(28px, 3vw, 48px) and under it a paragraph of 34ch at 17px. Columns 1–4 stay empty. At the right margin each row carries one photograph, top-aligned with its title and deliberately unequal: 240px wide at 4:5 in one row, 320px at 3:2 in the next, 180px square after that. Rows are separated by 96–120px of space, not lines. On a saturated field, set all type in one pale ink and leave the photographs ungraded.
sections.mobile: The axis collapses to the left margin. The statement sits at 9vw in 50svh of empty ground. Each row stacks its title at 26px, the paragraph, then its photograph at alternating widths: 100%, 70% flush right, 55% flush left. 64px between rows.

sections.name: Band of unequal panels
sections.blueprint: A modest heading, then one wide band of pictures. The heading, two to four words at 36–44px, starts at column 3, left of centre, with 64px beneath it. The band spans the full viewport width edge to edge and is 68svh tall: four photographs standing side by side with no gaps and deliberately unequal widths, a flex row with flex-grow values of 5, 2, 3 and 2. Each panel is cropped with object-fit: cover to a tall slice, so the band reads as one folded view. The first panel carries a two-line title at 28px in paper colour at its top-left, 24px in, over a neutral scrim that covers only that corner. Hovering a panel raises its flex-grow to 6 over 500ms while the others give way; without hover the widths simply stay. One caption line at 16px sits under the band at the left margin.
sections.mobile: The heading sits on the margin at 28px. The band becomes a two-by-two block with no gaps, 84svh tall in total: the first row split 64/36 and the second 36/64, so the slices stay unequal. The title stays on the first panel. No hover behaviour.

sections.name: One long letter
sections.blueprint: A single testimonial given room to be read, set like a letter. One column 34–38ch wide begins at column 5 of 12, or shares the page's own reading column. The first sentence of the quotation is pulled up as the opening line at 28–32px in medium weight, two lines at most. The rest follows as two or three ordinary paragraphs at 18–19px with leading 1.55 and 20px between paragraphs, in the full ink, not grey. It closes the way a letter does: 40px of space, then the name on one line and the role on the next at 16px. In columns 1–3, top-aligned with the first line, sits either nothing or one small square photograph of the writer, 120px wide. There are no quotation marks at all; the letter form makes them unnecessary. Space above and below is 140px.
sections.mobile: The column takes the full width with 20px margins. If there is a photograph it goes first at 96px square, left-aligned. Opening sentence at 24px, body at 17px, sign-off beneath. Nothing else changes; this section is already a phone composition.

sections.name: The idea again, inverted
sections.blueprint: The close flips the page's colours: ink becomes the ground and the ground becomes the ink, across a full-bleed field at least 90svh tall. The page's opening idea returns as a headline of three to five words at 9–11vw on two lines, leading 0.9, flush left, positioned in the upper two-thirds; it should echo the hero's wording, not repeat it. Along the bottom, on one shared baseline 40px above the edge: one supporting sentence at 20px in columns 1–5 and one rectangular button in the accent colour, right-aligned in columns 10–12, about 56px tall. Nothing else: no image, no second button, no logo. The field's top edge is a hard horizontal line where it meets the section above. If the footer follows on the same inverted field, leave 160px before it so the close still reads as its own screen.
sections.mobile: The same inverted field at 80svh. Headline at 15vw on two lines at the top. The sentence sits lower at 17px, and the button spans the full width at the bottom, 56px tall, with 20px margins. Nothing else is added.

sections.name: Columns above, wordmark below
sections.blueprint: The footer inverts ground and ink and fills a whole viewport (min-height 100svh), arranged as three rows in a grid (auto 1fr auto). Top row, 40px from the edge: four small columns on the 12-column grid (address, navigation, social, hours or contact), each a plain list at 15–16px with its first line in the full ink and the rest in the softer ink. Middle row: empty. Bottom row: the wordmark alone, sized to run from the left margin to the right margin on one line. Set it as inline SVG text with a `viewBox` fitted to the word and `width: 100%`, or tune `font-size` in `vw` to the letter count, so it never wraps; its baseline sits 20px above a single line of legal text at 13px. With `position: sticky; bottom: 0` and a lower `z-index` than the page, the last section slides away to uncover it.
sections.mobile: Columns become two by two at 15px with 32px between rows, at the top. A gap of about 20svh follows. The wordmark spans the full width at the bottom; a name longer than ten letters stacks on two lines, each fitted to the width. Legal line beneath at 12px.

references.name: Artem Taradash
references.idea: A designer's CV compressed into one newspaper-like band at the top, after which oversized product renders and project artefacts speak at full scale.
references.hero: White page with 20px margins. Top-left are three small black rectangular tags with white text (name and two links). Below them a three-line statement at about 3vw in regular-weight grotesk fills the first third, left-aligned. To its right, starting at the very top edge, run two narrow columns of 12px text, then a third column listing clients one per line, and in the far top-right a circular portrait about 200px wide with a white hand-lettered word across the face. This text band ends by a quarter of the height. Below it a huge cut-out vehicle render bleeds off the bottom, with a project card at right.
references.type: One family, Diatype, in regular weight throughout. Three sizes: about 43px for statements and project titles, 12.4px for all running text, about 11px for tags. Tight leading, sentence case, no bold and no capitals; hierarchy comes from size alone.
references.colour: #ffffff #111111 #f7f9fb #1c4fd8 #f0a23a — Strictly black on white for the frame. All colour arrives with project material: an orange-to-blue gradient, a cobalt zigzag pattern, warm photography.
references.imagery: Product renders cut out on white and shown very large, interface screenshots with a small corner radius, a full-width studio photo with a circular logo overlaid, and textile-pattern fields running margin to margin. Scale varies sharply between projects.
references.layout: A loose six-column grid with 20px margins; small text blocks hang from column lines beside very large images. Each project is arranged differently, and there are no dividers or section backgrounds, only white space and jumps in scale. The tag nav stays fixed top-left.

sections.description: Each project pairs one oversized visual with a small caption cluster. In the first, a cut-out product render fills the left 60% and bleeds off the edge. The right third stacks a landscape screenshot with slightly rounded corners, then a row holding a tiny label and two-line title at about 3vw on the left and a five-line 12px description on the right.

A row of three: a round black watch-face mock-up about a quarter of the width, a wide rectangle filled with a horizontal blue, violet, orange, blue gradient with a tiny tick scale beneath it, and a narrow text column at far right with label, three-line title and two short paragraphs. Circle, rectangle and text share a top line.

A cobalt-and-white zigzag textile pattern runs margin to margin for more than a full viewport height with only a two-line caption beneath it at left. Before it, a black-backed mosaic of pattern samples and report-cover mock-ups sits beside two narrow text columns. The pattern is given a section to itself with no mock-up frame.

Closing row on white: a tiny label, then a four-line sentence at about 3vw in the left third; a small square portrait at the two-thirds mark; to its right a short question with two underlined links below. All three hang from the same top line with empty space between them.

steal: Put bio, client list and portrait in one compact multi-column band at the top so the first scroll is already work.
Use solid black rectangular tags with white text as the only navigation chrome.
Let one project artefact (a pattern, a gradient) run full width for a whole screen with a two-line caption instead of framing it in a mock-up.

references.name: Architecture of Socialist-Era Belgrade
references.idea: A two-colour printed guidebook on screen: signal-red type over greyscale concrete, with one modular display face as the only ornament.
references.hero: Full-bleed greyscale photograph of brutalist housing towers; pale sky fills the top half, concrete the bottom. The title is set over the sky, flush left at a 32px margin, three lines in a wide modular display face at 102px (7.1vw) in flat red, the longest line reaching 92% of the width, leading so tight that the lines almost touch. Under it, one row at 24px: a red one-line descriptor at left, and two paler-red facts right-aligned (an object count and a date range). Top-right, the word 'Index' with a diagonal arrow. No logo, no button, nothing else. Red and grey only.
references.type: IntraNet, a wide modular display face with rounded, notched corners, used only for the title and its footer repeat. Funnel Sans carries the rest: about 50px for the long intro, 40px bold uppercase entry titles, 24px meta, 13px credits. Four sizes, two faces.
references.colour: #f53843 #d1d1d1 #c7c7c7 #777777 #f1a7ab — Strictly red and grey: red text on grey photo or grey paper, then pale grey text on a solid red field for the essay and footer. Photographs are desaturated so nothing breaks the pair.
references.imagery: Contemporary black-and-white architectural photographs of concrete towers and complexes, frontal or looking up, with big skies and visible grain; full-bleed in the hero, full column width and square-cornered in entries.
references.layout: 16 to 32px margins, everything flush left. A long red essay block in very large text, then twenty repeated entry blocks on grey: a two-column header split by a vertical red hairline, a meta row, then a wide photo. 81 screens of the same rhythm.

sections.description: Immediately under the hero photo a solid red field begins with no gap. The essay runs as one full-width column in pale grey sans at roughly 50px with tight leading, about 50 characters per line, paragraphs separated by one blank line, with no headings, pull-quotes or images for several screens. The photo's bottom edge butts straight against the red.

Each building entry sits on light grey paper: a thin red rule across the top, then two columns divided by a vertical red hairline at the 50% mark. Left: the building's name in red bold uppercase at 40px over two lines. Right: its dates in pale red at the same size. Below, a small meta row with 'Credits' and 'Address' labels and values in 13px red, then a full-width greyscale photograph.

Solid red. At the top, two short 13px notes side by side in pale grey occupy the left 60%, a back-to-top link sits far right, and a third note runs beneath. A tall empty red gap follows. Then the full title is repeated in the display face at hero size but in pale grey, flush left, above a single row of small meta: sources link left, font credits centre, city and year right.

steal: Limit the page to one saturated colour and one grey, desaturate all photos, and invert the pair (grey on red) for long reading blocks.
Set the title in a distinctive modular display face directly on the sky area of a photo and repeat it in the footer in the inverse colour.
Put facts in the hero as a right-aligned row of paler-tint figures (count, date range) on the same baseline as the subtitle.

references.name: Pensatori Irrazionali
references.idea: The client roster becomes the hero object, a 3D sheaf of logo-printed fabric ribbons, and classical Italian ornament (copperplate script, engravings, tricolour) is collided with plain Helvetica.
references.archetype: other: offset 3d object with bottom-left statement
references.hero: Flat pale-grey field (#f5f5f5). A 3D-rendered bundle of woven fabric ribbons, each a different saturated colour and printed with a client logo, streams diagonally from beyond the top-right corner down to about centre-left, covering roughly the right two-thirds and bleeding off the top and right edges. Top-left: a small engraved lion crest with serif wordmark and a green-white-red bar. Top-right: two dark square icon buttons with chamfered corners. Bottom-left, in the lowest fifth: a tiny '+ (Atelier)' label above a three-line grey intro paragraph at about 36px, half the viewport wide. No headline and no call to action; the left third is empty.
references.type: Helvetica Now at regular weight does nearly everything, tracking -0.025em, sentence case, from 14px body to 60px menu links. Section titles pair it with huge hairline copperplate script words, and the footer wordmark is a heavy high-contrast serif at about 18vw.
references.colour: #f5f5f5 #434343 #292828 #e9e9e9 #e3342a #2bd92b — One pale grey ground throughout with charcoal rather than black text. Saturated colour is confined to the ribbon render and project images, plus a green and red flag underline and one neon-green dot.
references.imagery: Hero 3D render of logo-printed textile ribbons; black engraved illustrations (angel, Pegasus, lion) cut out and placed inside headings; dark-grey map silhouettes; square-cornered project stills in a horizontal row.
references.layout: Narrow 48px side margins with content hung on a loose two-column split at 50%. Sections alternate between oversized title bands that bleed off both edges and small hairline-ruled tabular lists, with generous blank grey between blocks.

sections.description: A title band runs edge to edge as one line: a hairline copperplate script word about 250px tall cropped by the left edge, a tiny superscript '(01)', a black engraving of an angel dropped in like an inline glyph, then a grotesk phrase at 90px running off the right edge. Beneath, two columns of client rows: name at about 40px, a tiny grey category label, the client's logo mark, a small arrow, each row closed by a hairline.

A grid of five columns by two rows of equal cells with faint 1px borders, each holding one small monochrome client logo, centred. Directly below, a wide empty band works as a map: a dark-grey country silhouette crops in at each side edge, with a two-line place name at 32px bottom-left and another bottom-right, each with tiny coordinates in parentheses underneath.

The same script-plus-engraving title band, now with a Pegasus and '(02)'. Below, a two-column table headed by tiny 'Number' and 'Service' labels over a hairline: the left column shows a giant hairline script numeral about 200px tall; the right holds a small '+ (Branding)' label, a service name with a neon-green dot, and ruled rows pairing a term at left with a grey descriptor right-aligned.

The first word of the name in a heavy high-contrast serif spans the full width and crops at the right edge (about 18vw), with a green underline under its left half and red under its right. Behind and below, the second word in giant pale-grey gradient script overlaps the serif letters. Under that, small columns: menu links at 18px, contact details at 11px, legal links at right.

steal: Turn the client-logo list into one physical object (logos printed on a rendered bundle of ribbons) so proof becomes the hero image instead of a logo strip.
Build section titles as one edge-to-edge line mixing a hairline script word, an inline engraved illustration and a plain grotesk phrase at similar height.
Keep the page on one pale grey with charcoal text and let colour enter only through imagery and a single flag-coloured underline on the footer wordmark.
references.media: A 3D cluster of logo-printed fabric ribbons covers about 60% of the first screen, bleeding off the top and right with the statement docked bottom-left. Below: engravings inserted between the words of a title marquee, hidden 16:9 previews behind a client index, three-up 16:9 tile rows overflowing the right edge as carousels, a single centred 16:9 video with wide ground either side, a staggered two-row collage bleeding off both edges, and map silhouettes cropped at the page edges; 39 images and 9 muted 16:9 videos, never under text.
references.motion: About 3-4s of intro after a 13.3s load: an inset crest card where a 2.25s fill keyframe runs, a white flash, the ribbons, then the copy de-blurring. Lenis with no pins: titles run as endless marquees, media rows are carousels, and content fades back in over 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1) after each scroll step; coordinates roll digit by digit over 900ms on a spring-shaped linear() curve (157 WAAPI calls), and the manifesto letters roll up from doubled glyphs.
